evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/b/a implements Runnable, owns two 500-entry int arrays plus a synchronized lock/count, and while enabled samples Client.hP/hQ into those arrays every 50 ms.
The worker stores the current static Client mouse coordinates directly and increments the sample count only while the 500-entry buffer has capacity; it has no unrelated protocol/gameplay state.

Multiple public 317/refactored client lineages expose class MouseDetection implementing Runnable with the same Client reference, sync object, coordsX/coordsY arrays of length 500, running flag/count and 50 ms sampling loop.

This class is distinct from R282 ClientInputEventQueue: MouseDetection periodically samples cursor position for the legacy mouse-movement reporting path, while R282 buffers discrete press/release/motion/reset input records.

candidates.note: Source-correlated exact-v308 recovery of the classic 317 MouseDetection worker. Public historical clients are corroborating lineage evidence; exact v308 behavior independently matches the role.
